metadata.waveform_kind: inertial-frame spherical harmonic mode h_22, not detector strain

reference_frequency.meaning: special value: initial model epoch; not a physical zero-frequency orbit

metadata.time_convention: model geometric time; t=0 at model total multimode waveform amplitude peak; not necessarily the h22 peak and not horizon common-formation time
metadata.frame: inertial: z along L and x from lighter to heavier BH at reference epoch; y completes right-handed triad
metadata.quaternion: [w,x,y,z]; active coprecessing-to-inertial rotation v_I = q v_C q^-1
metadata.dynamics_cutoff_reason: At t/M=-100 the NR training spins are extended by PN equations; later spins are unphysical fit parameters (Varma et al. 2019, Sec. III C). Direction display is conservatively cut at this boundary too.
notes: No mapping to SXS coordinate clocks is assumed.
This demonstration is inside the training domain, not an accuracy assessment against independent NR waveforms.
